name: Grenada National Museum
scope: The original corner museum building and its immediately attached Monckton Street balcony wing in St. George’s.
era: Standing masonry street-front blocks. The 1902 Home Hotel photograph fixes the surviving exterior features, with the later balcony documented by the museum.

externalReferences.artist: The Grenada Handbook, Directory and Almanac (1902 publisher)

reverseEvidence.note: Harvard title leaf names and dates the London imprint to 1902.

originalReview.notes: The original anonymously published 1902 frontispiece is isolated from the left half of an archival comparison. The newer image and collage arrangement were excluded. Retained crop bounds [0,0,800,548]; the native source composite hash is recorded below.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla gallery. Its images are outside the public-domain or CC0 policy. Used the isolated original 1902 Home Hotel frontispiece from the museum archive and the independently digitized period title and catalogue.
